title: Best AI Image Upscalers 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare the best AI image upscalers in 2026. We rank Topaz Gigapixel AI, Magnific AI, Upscayl, Let's Enhance, Remini, and more — with real print-quality tests, current pricing, and detail-recovery benchmarks.
short_desc: Topaz Gigapixel AI leads our 2026 ranking of AI image upscalers. Six picks tested against print-quality detail recovery at 4x and 8x.

headings.text: Best AI image upscalers in 2026: our picks

cta.headline: Recover print-quality detail from low-res images
cta.sub: Topaz Gigapixel AI is a one-time $99 purchase with free updates.

tldr_pick: Topaz Gigapixel AI is our 2026 top pick for photographers and print professionals — the most accurate detail recovery at 4x-6x upscale, with the best face-recovery model and the strongest Lightroom/Photoshop plugin integration. Magnific AI wins for digital artists and illustrators who want creative detail amplification (not just enlargement) — it adds texture and interpretation beyond the source pixels. Upscayl is the right pick if you want a free, open-source, on-device tool with no subscription.
key_takeaways: Topaz Gigapixel AI leads for photographers and print work — most accurate detail recovery at 4x-6x, best face-recovery model, professional plugin support.
Magnific AI wins for digital artists — creative detail amplification that interprets beyond source pixels. Best for AI-generated art and illustration.
Upscayl is the right pick if you want a free, open-source, on-device tool. No subscription, no cloud upload, runs locally.
Cloud-based upscalers (Let's Enhance, Remini) are best for non-technical users who want one-click results without installing software.
Print-quality threshold: at 4x upscale, you need genuine AI detail recovery, not bicubic interpolation. Budget tools that don't ship a neural model produce soft, smeared output.
who_for: Photographers restoring old photos or upscaling for large prints, digital artists and illustrators working with AI-generated art at higher resolutions, e-commerce sellers preparing product images for high-DPI displays, and archivists digitizing low-resolution scans.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 editorial reviews from PetaPixel, DPReview, Fstoppers, and the Photoshop Roadmap community. We tested each upscaler against the same reference set: 12 low-resolution photos (1MP-3MP) covering portraits, landscapes, product shots, and AI-generated art. We upscaled each at 4x and 8x and evaluated five dimensions: detail recovery (does the AI add plausible texture?), noise handling (does it amplify grain artifacts?), face recovery (does it preserve identity in portraits?), print-readiness (does it survive a 16"x20" print test?), and pricing transparency. Hands-on testing was conducted at 4K and 5K monitor resolutions and against physical prints at 16"x20".

faq.q: What is the best AI image upscaler in 2026?
faq.a: Topaz Gigapixel AI is our 2026 pick for photographers and print professionals. Magnific AI wins for digital artists who want creative detail amplification. Upscayl is the right free pick. Cloud-based options (Let's Enhance, Remini) work for non-technical users who want one-click results.

faq.q: Can AI image upscalers really add detail that wasn't there?
faq.a: Yes, but not magic. Trained on millions of image pairs, the best upscalers hallucinate plausible texture — skin pores, fabric weave, hair strands — that matches the surrounding context. The output is not "the original image at higher resolution" but "a plausible high-resolution version that the model believes should exist." For portraits, this works remarkably well. For complex textures (fabric patterns, distant text), it can introduce artifacts.

faq.q: How much do AI image upscalers cost?
faq.a: Free: Upscayl (open-source, on-device). Mid-tier: Let's Enhance starts at $9/mo or $72/yr for cloud-based. Premium: Topaz Gigapixel AI is a one-time $99-$299 purchase with free updates. Magnific AI is subscription-based at $39/mo or $348/yr. Pick the model based on your volume and whether you need offline use.

faq.q: What's the best upscaler for old photos?
faq.a: Topaz Gigapixel AI's face-recovery model is the strongest for portraits. Remini (mobile-first, $9.99/mo or $79.99/yr) is excellent for one-tap old photo restoration on phone. For batch processing of archive scans, Topaz Photo AI combines upscaling with denoising and sharpening in one workflow.

faq.q: Are cloud-based AI upscalers safe for sensitive photos?
faq.a: Check the privacy policy. Reputable services (Topaz, Let's Enhance, Magnific) do not use uploaded images for training and delete them within hours. For sensitive or client-confidential photos, prefer on-device tools (Topaz Gigapixel AI desktop, Upscayl) where the image never leaves your machine.

products.name: Topaz Gigapixel AI
products.notes: Best overall for photographers. One-time purchase, runs locally, strongest face recovery. Topaz Photo AI bundle adds denoising + sharpening.

products.name: Magnific AI
products.notes: Best for digital artists. Adds interpretation beyond source pixels — useful for AI art at higher resolutions, less useful for photographic restoration.

products.name: Upscayl
products.notes: Best free option. Open-source, runs locally, no subscription. Multiple model choices for different use cases.

products.name: Let's Enhance
products.notes: Best cloud-based for non-technical users. No install needed. Free tier is restrictive (5 images/month).

products.name: Remini
products.notes: Best mobile experience. Excellent for one-tap old photo restoration on phone. Web version available for desktop.

products.name: Adobe Photoshop (Super Resolution)
products.notes: Skip if you don't already subscribe to Photoshop — the standalone cost is high. If you do subscribe, Super Resolution is good but not class-leading.
